name: BOC International (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: BOC International (China) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the securities business in China. The company offers equity and debt financing, financial advisory, and new third board services; research and institutional business services; wealth management, including financial product distribution, PB services, investment advisory, and repurchase; securities brokerage; credit, such as margin trading, securities lending, and stock pledge; stock options; intermediary business services; and investment management.
